instructions.name: init_config
docs: Initializes the program configuration account

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin authority that will control the program

instructions.name: create_warehouse
docs: Admin creates a warehouse keyed by an explicit id

instructions.name: update_warehouse
docs: Admin patches a warehouse: operator, pickup notes, fee or zip prefixes

instructions.name: register_farmer
docs: Farmer registers and requests a warehouse

instructions.name: set_farmer_warehouse
docs: Warehouse operator approves the farmer's requested warehouse

instructions.name: register_customer
docs: Customer registers a profile

instructions.name: request_customer_confirmation
docs: Customer asks a warehouse to confirm them (address exchanged off-chain)

instructions.name: confirm_customer
docs: Warehouse operator confirms a customer; also re-admits a revoked one

instructions.name: revoke_customer
docs: Warehouse operator revokes a pending or confirmed customer

instructions.name: publish_offer
docs: Approved farmer publishes a transparent lot offer keyed by an explicit id

accounts.name: mint
docs: The payment mint, an account and not an argument so its token extensions can be read here.

instructions.name: deactivate_offer
docs: Farmer stops purchases on an offer

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Admin pauses or resumes market actions

instructions.name: create_order
docs: Confirmed customer buys from an offer: reserves stock and escrows the subtotal

instructions.name: quote_delivery_fee
docs: Warehouse operator quotes the delivery fee of a pending delivery order

instructions.name: accept_delivery_fee
docs: Customer accepts the quote and escrows the delivery fee

instructions.name: reject_delivery_fee
docs: Customer rejects the quote: subtotal refunded, stock restored, order canceled

accounts.name: customer
docs: Also the escrow rent destination, so it must be writable.

instructions.name: refuse_delivery
docs: Warehouse operator refuses a delivery order before transit: full refund, stock restored

accounts.name: customer_token_account
docs: Any token account of the order's customer for this mint; the operator picks it, the owner check keeps the money with the customer.

accounts.name: customer
docs: Escrow rent goes back to the customer, who paid it at `create_order`.

instructions.name: mark_in_transit
docs: Warehouse operator locks the order for transport; mandatory before completion

instructions.name: complete_order
docs: Warehouse operator completes the order: escrow released to farmer and logistics

accounts.name: farmer_token_account
docs: Must already exist; the program does not create payout accounts.

accounts.name: customer
docs: Escrow rent goes back to the customer, who paid it at `create_order`.

instructions.name: expire_order
docs: Anyone expires a pre-transit order past expires_at: full refund, stock restored

accounts.name: customer_token_account
docs: Any token account of the order's customer for this mint; the owner check keeps the refund with the customer.

accounts.name: customer
docs: Escrow rent goes back to the customer, who paid it at `create_order`.
